items.title: Pay annual electricity statement balance
items.quote: Please pay the balance within 14 days of the statement date.
items.computation: Anchor: statement/document date 20 Nov 2026 (Friday). Sender is a private company, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the printed statement date itself as stated in the letter. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (20 Nov) is not counted, so counting starts 21 Nov 2026. 14 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) falls on 4 Dec 2026 (Friday). That day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Due date = 4 Dec 2026.

items.title: New, higher monthly instalment takes effect
items.quote: Your new monthly instalment from December is €94.00.
items.computation: The letter only says the new instalment of €94.00 applies 'from December' without naming the exact collection day each month; taking the first day of December 2026 as the earliest plausible start of the new instalment regime gives 2026-12-01, but the precise due day for the first affected instalment payment is not stated.
